notes: Only name and description are required; all other fields are optional.
Misspelled frontmatter keys are ignored silently (no error) — they do not take effect.
The markdown body below the frontmatter becomes the agent's system prompt.
Plugin-supplied subagents ignore the hooks, mcpServers, and permissionMode fields.
Fields with open value sets (tools, model full IDs) list examples/patterns rather than a closed enum.
effort's usable values depend on the chosen model — cross-check against model_efforts.json.

name.description: Unique identifier using lowercase letters and hyphens. Filename need not match; hooks receive this value as agent_type.

description.description: When Claude should delegate to this subagent. Drives automatic delegation; be concrete about triggering conditions.

tools.value_format: Comma-separated string (e.g. 'Read, Grep, Glob, Bash') or YAML list.
valid_values: Tool names, e.g. Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob, Bash
Agent (allow spawning any subagent) or Agent(type1, type2) (allowlist)
tools.default: inherits all tools available in the main conversation
tools.description: Strict allowlist of tools the subagent may use. If no entry resolves to a real tool, the subagent fails to launch. Use the skills field to preload skills rather than listing Skill here.

valid_values: MCP patterns: mcp__<server>, mcp__<server>__*, or mcp__* (all MCP tools)
disallowedTools.description: Denylist of tools, removed from the inherited or specified set. Applied before tools is resolved.

model.also_accepts: A full model ID such as claude-opus-4-8 or claude-sonnet-5 (same values as the --model flag).
model.description: Model the subagent runs on: an alias, a full model ID, or inherit (use the main conversation's model).

effort.description: Reasoning/effort level while this subagent is active; overrides the session effort level. Available levels depend on the model (see model_efforts.json). 'ultracode' is a Claude Code menu concept, not a valid frontmatter value.

enum_notes.manual: Alias for default; requires Claude Code v2.1.200 or later.

permissionMode.description: How the subagent handles permission prompts. Ignored for plugin subagents. A parent using bypassPermissions, acceptEdits, or auto takes precedence and cannot be overridden.

maxTurns.description: Maximum number of agentic turns before the subagent stops.

skills.description: Skill names to preload into the subagent's context at startup (full skill content is injected). Cannot preload skills that set disable-model-invocation: true.

mcpServers.value_format: Each entry is either a string naming an already-configured server, or an inline server definition object keyed by server name.
mcpServers.description: MCP servers scoped to this subagent. Ignored for plugin subagents.

hooks.value_format: Object keyed by hook event; each event maps to a list of { matcher, hooks: [{ type, command }] } entries.
hooks.description: Lifecycle hooks scoped to this subagent. All hook events are supported; the listed ones are most common. Stop is converted to SubagentStop at runtime. Ignored for plugin subagents.

memory.description: Persistent memory scope enabling cross-session learning. Enables Read/Write/Edit tools automatically so the subagent can manage its memory files.

background.default: unset (Claude decides; runs in background by default as of v2.1.198)
background.description: Set to true to always run this subagent as a background task, even when Claude needs its result right away.

isolation.description: Set to worktree to run the subagent in a temporary git worktree with an isolated copy of the repository. 'worktree' is the only valid value; omit the field entirely for no isolation.

color.description: Display color for the subagent in the task list and transcript.

initialPrompt.description: Auto-submitted as the first user turn when this agent runs as the main session agent (via --agent or the agent setting). Commands and skills are processed; prepended to any user-provided prompt.
